description: Discovers and acquires the newest final NCUA quarterly Call Report ZIP, then normalizes federally insured credit unions, reported U.S. locations, trade names, ZIP coverage, provenance, and explicit exclusions.
retry: Retry discovery or archive requests with capped exponential backoff; never retry schema, cycle, checksum, or quality failures.
checkpoint: The complete official ZIP is retained and hashed before normalization; publication is run-scoped and current.json changes only after all quality gates pass.
idempotency: The source release is identified by cycle date and archive SHA-256; charter number and composite charter/site identifiers produce stable entity candidates.
cancellation: Abort the active request, leave unpublished staging run-scoped, and do not change current.json before complete publication.
retention_profile: Retain immutable public source archives and normalized releases until an approved retention operation removes them.
